_readme: Entries shown on /changelog/, newest first. date is ISO (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the day is not recorded); text is one or two short factual sentences.

entries.title: Reader pages
entries.text: Added About this book, Start here with reading paths, Credits and licence, and this changelog. Every page now has a link for reporting a correction.

entries.title: Appendix
entries.text: Added an appendix of short entries. Six profiles with a smaller body of original teaching moved there, and their old addresses redirect to the new entries.

entries.title: Unverified claims
entries.text: Claims that could not be confirmed were cut or marked "(unverified)" in the text.

entries.title: Scope
entries.text: Removed legal proceedings, allegations and political controversy not needed for the teaching, across the book, which now keeps to teaching, lineage and practice.

entries.title: Third-person voice
entries.text: The narrator's voice changed from first person to third person throughout. Verdict boxes are now labelled "Verdict".

entries.title: Launch
entries.text: The book opened to search engines.

entries.title: Fact-check follow-up
entries.text: Open questions raised by the fact-checkers were worked through file by file. Each claim was verified, attributed, hedged or cut.

entries.title: First drafts
entries.text: Chapters, profiles, sidebars and part introductions drafted and independently fact-checked, with the lineage tree, timeline, map, glossary and search.
